description: This file defines a function 'infer_schema' used to parse and generate schema strings for functions based on their type annotations, primarily for use with PyTorch custom operators. It includes utility functions for handling type conversions, supported parameter types, and return types, as well as class and method definitions related to schema inference.

methods.name: infer_schema
methods.description: Parses a function's type hints to generate a schema string for PyTorch custom operators.

methods.name: derived_types
methods.description: Generates type variations for a base type with different qualifiers and container types.

methods.name: get_supported_param_types
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of supported parameter types and their schema representations.

methods.name: parse_return
methods.description: Converts a return type annotation into a schema string, validating supported types.

methods.name: supported_param
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is supported based on its kind.

methods.name: tuple_to_list
methods.description: Converts a typing.Tuple type into a corresponding list type with the same type arguments.
